clauses.section: ## CL-D107 — A gate result whose correlation names no run is relaunched once
requires: issues/254#issuecomment-6040793987
issues/254#issuecomment-6041458658
A designated output whose correlation has `baseOid` and `headOid` both 40 zeros and `contractInput` and `snapshotFingerprint` both 64 zeros names no run.
A correlation that names any real value, another run's result included, stays a refusal at once.
Exact autofix relaunches it within CL-D51's budget: once per run, never after the writer has launched, after the target is rechecked.
A second relaunch, a larger budget, or a weaker test than all four null values requires a new owner decision.
